summaryZh: Daniel Simpson 的研究组研究非侵入肿瘤成像标志物，并将新成像技术纳入放疗计划。项目评估肿瘤对放疗、化疗和免疫治疗的反应，开发临床试验以支持个体化治疗。
researchQuestions: 肿瘤如何响应放疗、化疗和免疫治疗？

evidence.quote: My research is focused on the use of non-invasive bioimaging markers in oncology and incorporation of novel imaging modalities into radiation treatment planning.
My research group is in the process of developing clinical trials
